column1: # Benchmark routes for scripts/bench.py: name, DM_KEYS (seconds from host start), measuring window start and length (s), description.

# base game on a 16 GB M6: the title, A through Single Player, Grand Prix, the character, the kart, the Mushroom Cup, 50cc and "Start Grand Prix?" (the cup's opening movie
# starts at about 56 s), A held to drive from 120 s. On 1.8.0 a run on an M4 Max reached the race at about 195 s (pull request #2064), so the windows here start at 215 s.
# Not yet run on an M2 Pro: check the two screenshots of a first run (is it the race?) before trusting any number, and move the window if loading takes longer here.
